It exists because tsx reads the tsconfig found from the cwd, and the root-invoked entries -- `npm run audit:schema-drift` and the identical bare `npx tsx scripts/assert-schema-drift.ts` that deploy-linux.sh runs from the release root -- had NO paths block at all, so `@ipodhan/shared*` fell through to node_modules. In a worktree whose node_modules was junctioned without re-pointing the workspace packages that reads the MAIN checkout, and the gate that fronts every release then reports on the wrong tree (item 1 slice s14).
